moments.author: Jensen Huang
moments.quote: “Open models strengthen safety and cybersecurity, accelerate innovation… The world needs both frontier closed models and frontier open models.”
moments.why: His first-ever X post argues against over-restricting open‑weight AI models—sparking big debate on openness in AI regulation.

moments.author: Sam Altman
moments.why: A short but pointed call for regulatory predictability amid global AI rule‑making, resonating with developers and policy watchers.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: It is pretentious and poisonous for for‑profit companies to call themselves “labs”… creates a “lords & peasants” culture between “researchers” and engineers.
moments.why: He reignites tension over US vs Chinese AI culture, framing a provocative critique that’s fueling industry conversation.
